description: This file defines the Base class within the PhpSpreadsheet library's MathTrig calculations, implementing the BASE function which converts a number into its textual representation in a specified base/radix. It includes methods for evaluating input parameters, handling array inputs, range validation, and performing the core conversion.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Provides a static method for converting numbers to different bases, supporting array inputs and integrating with the PhpSpreadsheet calculation framework.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Main method to convert a number into a string in a specified base, handling scalar or array inputs, validating parameters, and delegating the conversion process.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Performs the actual base conversion if parameters are within valid ranges, returns the converted string padded to minimum length if specified, or handles errors.
